purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point (Kayseri).
primaryPublisher: Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality; General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre (TKGM)
registryBasis: Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality publishes its city guide and cadastral GIS activity page, while TKGM provides the national parcel-query service. The municipal cadastral app is described as login-accessible; an anonymous one-point request through the reviewed TKGM adapter was blocked upstream (HTTP 403). These sources establish registry/map infrastructure, not usable Kayseri vector coverage.

officialSources.observation: Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality’s CBS activities page identifies municipal cadastral map activity and links its city-guide map; the cadastral application is described as requiring user login.
Official municipal city-guide map landing page; no anonymous parcel vector schema verified.
TKGM public parcel-search page documents coordinate-based parcel display and states owner/name or Turkish identity-number queries are not available.
Official public parcel viewer identified; one safe point request to its service through the reviewed adapter was blocked upstream with HTTP 403.
